verdict.rationale: Replicate is an API platform, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent: the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt and docs.md files are LLM-friendly documentation, which is adjacent material and not an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
